verdict.rationale: Vanta has first-party product pages for HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI, alongside SOC 2 and ISO 27001. Its homepage claims SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and 35+ frameworks, with controls cross-mapped and reused across frameworks on one GRC platform. That directly matches the 'same platform, no new tool' need. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-framework use, and in-depth framework-specific documentation (e.g., PCI DSS scope/version details, GDPR privacy workflow specifics) beyond marketing-level claims.
